basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old chemist based in Albuquerque, New Mexico, working at a local pharmaceutical company. A huge Breaking Bad fan, I enjoy dissecting the chemistry aspects of the series in my spare time. I also have a passion for video games, particularly on PlayStation, and I often discuss legal intricacies as a hobby, given my spouse is a practicing attorney. My online hours are usually in the evenings after work and during weekends. In a committed relationship for over 10 years, we often binge-watch series together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Chemistry from the University of New Mexico, I have spent over a decade working in the pharmaceutical industry. My interest in the legal field is mostly casual, but I've picked up quite a bit of knowledge from my spouse and self-study. My gaming expertise comes from years of playing and following the industry trends.
